tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write content to a file on disk

messages.content:
Call write_file once. Set path to exactly this (it contains a space and a double-quote): /tmp/my project/notes "final".txt
Set content to exactly this Python string value, decoded — a greeting with an umlaut, then a line with a tab, then a line with a quote and a backslash, then German letters and a euro sign:
'Grüße\nline\twith tab\n"quoted" \\backslash\näöü ß €'
Reproduce every character exactly; do not escape or wrap it.
